correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the other Bernoulli variables proves the sitewise nonextremality bound. Two sites with probability 1/k or 1-1/k in the same window have largest exact-count probability strictly below 1-1/k (k>=3); hence marks are w-separated, while window sums force periodic deterministic labels. This proves a bijection to spaced subsets and the exact weighted census. Finite-state Perron growth yields the root; the union-bound sandwich yields the cross-resolution exponent. Standalone exact-arithmetic checks of 459 small cases passed.
